title: Probavi adapter protocol v0 — provision request payload
description: Backup source, sandbox guarantees, and optional PITR target handed to the adapter (adapter-protocol.md §6.2). Secrets never appear here: credentials travel in environment variables whose names are listed in source.credential_env (§2.5).
$comment: Derived from docs/adapter-protocol.md, which is normative. On any disagreement the markdown document wins.

params.description: Engine-specific drill-config settings, passed through the core untouched.

credential_env.description: Names of environment variables passed through to the adapter process — names only, never values.

pitr.description: Present only when the drill requests point-in-time recovery and probe declared pitr: true for the chosen source kind.
